status: descriptive event-definition audit; no physical lock, CSD, equilibrium-law or bifurcation inference

pipeline_fixed.scope: estimated once from the complete archive; held fixed during prefix audit; not online recalibration

definitions.causal_K: first completion of K consecutive H decisions, available at window END; reset across time gaps
definitions.suffix80: first H index for which >=80% of all remaining observed decisions are H; retrospective and horizon dependent
definitions.not_detected: no detector event by the final observed window END; no cure fraction or permanent non-H assertion
definitions.prefix_test: full-series event counts only if its index is in the prefix; compare with event recomputed from that same prefix
definitions.H_episode: contiguous labelled H decision run; decision-time span, not latent physical dwell duration
definitions.force_filtering: NONE in primary audit; legacy per-window force>0 filtering audited separately
definitions.causality_scope: conditional on fixed archive-level classifier constants; current nuisance estimation is not an online algorithm

limitations: Window overlap causes strong dependence; decision counts and prefix comparisons are not independent trials.
Changing force and design-confounded acceleration/travel prevent attributing detection times to relaxation at constant force.
The H classifier is a waveform proxy, not independent contact-state truth.
Later non-H decisions may reflect switching, changing controls or detector noise; this audit does not distinguish them.
Different window lengths change detector bias and latency; they are not interchangeable physical clocks.
Prefix stability establishes a stopping rule under fixed labels; it does not establish independent censoring for a survival model.
